entries.title: Psalms 63:1
segments: <<A Psalm of David when he was in the wilderness of Judah.>> O God, thou art my God; earnestly will I seek thee: My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.

entries.title: Psalms 63:2
segments: So have I looked upon thee in the sanctuary, To see thy power and thy glory.

entries.title: Psalms 63:3
segments: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, My lips shall praise thee.

entries.title: Psalms 63:4
segments: So will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 63:5
segments: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; And my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips;

entries.title: Psalms 63:6
segments: When I remember thee upon my bed, [And] meditate on thee in the night-watches.

entries.title: Psalms 63:7
segments: For thou hast been my help, And in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 63:8
segments: My soul followeth hard after thee: Thy right hand upholdeth me.

entries.title: Psalms 63:9
segments: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, Shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 63:10
segments: They shall be given over to the power of the sword: They shall be a portion for foxes.

entries.title: Psalms 63:11
segments: But the king shall rejoice in God: Every one that sweareth by him shall glory; For the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
